subject: CortexLabs onboarding: phased dedicated slab sizing and APAC pilot
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@cortexlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cortexlabs.com
Date: 2025-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + dedicated capacity needs for CortexLabs

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the time last week. We've gone through our forecast and want to discuss a dedicated capacity arrangement with Redwood. High level:
- Initial production in US (west coast) for low-latency serving to customers
- EU footprint for GDPR-sensitive tenants next quarter
- APAC pilot (Singapore) for month 4 contingent on performance

Estimated steady-state Q1: 120 rtx-8000-equivalent GPUs (mixed batch/real-time), burst lanes for peak weekends (~30% additional).
Can you put together a phased sizing and onboarding approach with SOW and timelines? Procurement is looping in to coordinate contract terms.

Attaching our internal technical reqs file (see stub below).

Thanks,
Anna
Head of ML Ops, CortexLabs

Attachments: Cortex_TechReqs.xlsx (sent separately by Procure)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@cortexlabs.com>
Cc: procure@cortexlabs.com
Date: 2025-09-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + dedicated capacity needs for CortexLabs

Hi Anna — great to hear these numbers. I attached an initial phased plan and SOW draft.

Quick summary of our recommended approach:
1) Phase 0 (30 days): Proof-of-concept in US with 20 reserved nodes (8xMTU rtx-class equivalents) + KV caching to hit latency targets.
2) Phase 1 (60–120 days): Expand to 80 reserved GPUs in US + 20 GPUs in EU (compliance-aware region) with canary rollout.
3) Phase 2 (month 4): APAC pilot (Singapore) 12 GPUs as a burstable pool, gated on perf/regression checks.

Sizing rationale: mix real-time small-batch lanes and batched inference lanes — will reduce token cost ~25% vs pure real-time. We'll include autoscale/burst clauses in SOW.

Next steps: I'll loop in Ben (capacity planning) and Irene (region ops) to finalize node mix and timeline. Can procurement share preferred payment terms (monthly vs quarterly commit)?

Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Cortex_v1.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-12T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Intro + dedicated capacity needs for CortexLabs

Mina — initial sizing thoughts from capacity team:
- US pool: recommend 1:1 mix of rtx-8000-equiv nodes and quantized A-series for batched workloads. Proposal: 70 rtx-equivalents + 50 quantized-batch nodes to meet 120 GPU-equivalent capacity while lowering cost.
- EU pool: start with 18 rtx-equivalents (scaled for compliance-tenants) and a small 4-node warm standby in Frankfurt.
- APAC pilot: 12 burstable nodes in Singapore; set up cross-region fallback to US for cold misses.

Risks:
- Procurement timelines could push EU activation by 6–8 weeks (data residency approvals).
- Network egress assumptions: ask Cortex to confirm expected token volumes for EU/US split.

I'll prepare a SKU-level cost delta (quantized vs full) and estimated provision lead times for each region.

—Ben

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-13T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Intro + dedicated capacity needs for CortexLabs

Adding ops perspective:
- EU compliance: we need SOC 2 + data residency checklist signed and a timeline of data flows. Recommend starting EU onboarding paperwork in parallel with US POC to avoid delays.
- Procurement: Marissa — can you own the SOW negotiation and confirm DocuSign cadence? We should include a 90-day ramp clause and a 30% commit for reserved capacity to secure node procurement.
- Network: will require private peering for EU production tenants; estimated networking setup = 3 weeks from order.

Irene
Head of Regional Ops

From: Anna Park <anna@cortexlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cortexlabs.com
Date: 2025-09-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + dedicated capacity needs for CortexLabs

Thanks — this looks good. Procurement confirmed quarterly billing preference and we'd like the APAC pilot gated on a 30-day perf SLA post-activation. Please send the cost delta and final SOW so we can loop legal. Also: can you include an explicit fallback policy for APAC->US during the pilot window?

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Anna
